mulan.sourceContext: Mulan takes her aging father's place in the army by disguising herself as a man. She initially struggles in training, then uses inventive tactics to protect her fellow soldiers. Even after her identity is exposed and she is dismissed, she returns to warn them of an attack and helps save the Emperor.

moana.sourceContext: Moana sails beyond her island's forbidden reef to restore Te Fiti's stolen heart and stop the blight harming her community. She learns wayfinding from Maui and continues when he leaves. Recognizing that Te Kā is Te Fiti without her heart, she restores what was taken instead of defeating another enemy.

elsa.sourceContext: Elsa hides her ice powers because she fears hurting Anna. When they are exposed at her coronation, she flees and unintentionally leaves Arendelle in winter. Her isolated ice palace does not resolve the harm; Anna's act of love helps her understand how to thaw the kingdom and reconnect with her sister.

joy.sourceContext: Joy tries to keep Riley happy through a difficult move to San Francisco. Separated from Headquarters with Sadness, she initially treats sadness as a problem to prevent. She eventually gives Sadness control, allowing Riley to tell her parents she misses home and to form a memory containing both happiness and sadness.

shrek.sourceContext: Shrek keeps others away because people judge him as a frightening ogre before knowing him. He accepts a quest to rescue Fiona in order to regain his swamp, with Donkey accompanying him. The journey leads him into friendship and love, challenging the solitude he originally wanted to protect.

miguel.sourceContext: Miguel teaches himself guitar despite his family's longstanding ban on music. His journey into the Land of the Dead brings an unexpected friendship with Héctor and a search through the family's history. His musical ambition is entangled with remembering ancestors and understanding the family traditions he resists.

mirabel.sourceContext: Mirabel receives no magical gift in a family whose children are valued for extraordinary abilities. When their house begins to crack, she investigates despite being dismissed. She learns how the pressure to be perfect affects Isabela and confronts the family's impossible expectations; reconciliation and rebuilding involve the whole family.

chihiro.sourceContext: Chihiro takes a job in Yubaba's spirit bathhouse to save her transformed parents. Yubaba takes part of her name and calls her Sen; remembering her real name becomes necessary to escape. Chihiro cleans a polluted river spirit, refuses No-Face's gold, and helps Haku recover the memory of his own identity.

geet.sourceContext: Geet misses her train while trying to help Aditya and draws him into her plan to run away to Anshuman. When Anshuman rejects her, she withdraws and becomes a schoolteacher. Aditya later helps her recover, reversing their earlier roles; she ultimately chooses him rather than returning to the relationship she first pursued.

rancho.sourceContext: Rancho challenges rote learning at engineering college and applies knowledge to practical problems. He urges Farhan to pursue photography rather than a career chosen for him, and helps Raju confront fear of failure. His conflict with the college director exposes the cost of measuring students only by grades and conventional success.

poo.sourceContext: Pooja, known as Poo, grows up in London after her sister Anjali and Rahul are estranged from his wealthy family. When Rohan arrives seeking his brother, she recognizes him and helps conceal his identity so he can enter the household. Behind her fashion-conscious college persona, she actively helps reunite the separated family.

rani.sourceContext: After her fiance cancels their wedding, Rani takes their planned honeymoon to Paris and Amsterdam alone. She forms friendships beyond her sheltered life and discovers she can earn money through her cooking. When Vijay seeks reconciliation but still criticizes her choices, she returns his ring and leaves the relationship.

bunny.sourceContext: Bunny pursues journalism and a life of travel, leaving his friends in India. Returning for Aditi's wedding brings him close to Naina again and exposes the relationships and family moments he has missed. He declines a job in Paris and proposes a shared life with Naina that can still include travel.

circuit.sourceContext: Circuit is Munna Bhai's lieutenant in a criminal syndicate and helps sustain Munna's false identity as a doctor. When Munna enters medical college, Circuit provides practical support outside campus. His loyalty helps Munna challenge impersonal treatment of patients, while also involving deception and unlawful shortcuts.

pushpa.sourceContext: Pushpa Raj rises from daily-wage labor into a red-sandalwood smuggling syndicate. His tactics challenge the bosses who control the trade, but his pursuit of status brings escalating criminal conflict. A public rejection by his half-brother over their father's surname makes humiliation and recognition concrete pressures in his story.

michael-scott.sourceContext: Michael Scott rises from successful salesman to regional manager and treats workplace relationships as personal friendships. His desire to be liked often conflicts with the authority and boundaries his employees need. He eventually leaves his job in Scranton to build a life with Holly in Colorado.

leslie-knope.sourceContext: Leslie Knope takes up Ann's complaint about a dangerous construction pit as a public-service project. Her city-council campaign later loses its professional managers after controversy over her relationship with Ben. Her colleagues organize the campaign themselves, returning the support she has given them, and she wins after a recount.

fleabag.sourceContext: Fleabag tries to keep the cafe she opened with her deceased friend Boo afloat while addressing the audience with jokes and asides. The story gradually reveals her guilt and damaged family relationships beneath that performance. Her later bond with a priest confronts her with intimacy, grief, and a relationship that cannot continue on her terms.

ted-lasso.sourceContext: Ted Lasso coaches AFC Richmond while encouraging players to develop as people as well as athletes. His optimism coexists with panic attacks, and he eventually accepts help from therapist Sharon Fieldstone. He reconciles with Nate after betrayal, then leaves Richmond to be present in his son's life in the United States.

phoebe-buffay.sourceContext: Phoebe writes and performs unconventional songs at Central Perk. A producer makes a music video for her song but replaces her voice with another singer's; a later partnership fails when her collaborator sells the song to an advertiser against her wishes. Her musical story puts recognition, control of one's work and commercial compromise in conflict.

chidi.sourceContext: Chidi Anagonye teaches moral philosophy but finds ordinary decisions painfully difficult, repeatedly hurting others through indecision. In The Good Place, he teaches Eleanor ethics and joins his friends in repeated attempts to become better people. His story tests whether knowing moral theories is enough to act well under uncertainty.

holt.sourceContext: Captain Raymond Holt wants to make the Nine-Nine a better precinct. He sees that Jake Peralta can solve cases but challenges him to develop discipline and become a leader. Their recurring conflict is between getting results through individual talent and accepting the professional standards and responsibility of a team.

wednesday.sourceContext: Wednesday Addams enters Nevermore Academy as an outsider and uses her psychic visions to investigate murders and prevent foreseen deaths. Her investigation forces her to work with other students, including her very different roommate Enid, rather than relying only on her own suspicions and solitary methods.

link.sourceContext: Link appears as different heroes across the history of Hyrule rather than one person living through every game. He carries the Triforce of Courage and takes on quests to protect Hyrule. In Twilight Princess, entering the Twilight transforms him into a wolf; he depends on Midna's help and learns to use animal abilities on the journey.

zelda.sourceContext: In Ocarina of Time, Princess Zelda hides from Ganondorf as Sheik and guides Link while protecting the Triforce of Wisdom. In The Wind Waker, her incarnation Tetra leads a pirate crew before learning her royal identity. These stories give her active responsibilities and identities beyond being a princess awaiting rescue.

lara-croft.sourceContext: Lara Croft learns to climb from her mentor Conrad Roth. On the search for Yamatai their roles shift: Roth backs Lara's choice of route for their ship, trusting her navigation.

peach.sourceContext: Princess Peach rules the Mushroom Kingdom and is repeatedly kidnapped by Bowser in the main Mario adventures. She also takes the lead in Super Princess Peach and Princess Peach: Showtime!, shifting from the person being rescued to the playable hero. Her role changes across these games rather than being limited to one passive story.

kratos.sourceContext: After his vengeance against the Greek gods, Kratos lives in the Norse realms with his son Atreus. He must teach and protect the boy while confronting his own rage. His task as a father includes preventing Atreus from repeating the violent mistakes that shaped his earlier life.

mario.sourceContext: Mario is a plumber who lives in the Mushroom Kingdom with his brother Luigi. In Super Mario adventures he crosses hazardous worlds and confronts Bowser to rescue Princess Peach. He also competes in racing and sports games and takes part in role-playing adventures, with different abilities and partners across those games.

leia.sourceContext: Leia hides the stolen Death Star plans in R2-D2 before the Empire captures her. She continues leading the rebellion after losing Alderaan. Later, when a new generation of political leaders sidelines her, she forms the Resistance to oppose the First Order rather than relying on her former position.

shuri.sourceContext: Shuri develops Wakanda's technology and helps T'Challa reclaim the throne. After losing her brother and mother, she reconstructs the heart-shaped herb and becomes the Black Panther. Although she defeats Namor, she chooses to spare him and offer an alliance rather than complete an act of revenge.

rey.sourceContext: Rey survives as a scavenger on Jakku while waiting for her family to return. Helping BB-8 draws her into the Resistance and a search for Jedi training. After learning that Palpatine is her grandfather, she rejects his plans, fights alongside the Jedi legacy and chooses the Skywalker name in honor of her mentors.

spock.sourceContext: Spock serves as the Enterprise's science officer and first officer, with both human and Vulcan heritage shaping his life. In The Wrath of Khan, he sacrifices himself to save the ship and crew. His later work includes diplomacy to prevent war with the Klingons, applying reason in service of others rather than treating logic as detachment alone.

gandalf.sourceContext: Gandalf guides Bilbo and later the Fellowship through knowledge, persuasion and timely help. He investigates the One Ring and works to unite others against Sauron. In Moria, he fights the Balrog so his companions can escape, dies and returns as Gandalf the White to continue the struggle.

tony-stark.sourceContext: Tony Stark changes direction after seeing the harm connected to his weapons business and builds the Iron Man armor. His attempt to protect the world through the Ultron program instead creates a destructive threat. He later rejoins the Avengers to reverse Thanos's actions and sacrifices himself to defeat Thanos and his army.

miles-morales.sourceContext: In Into the Spider-Verse, Miles Morales gains powers while struggling with expectations at school and home. After his world's Spider-Man dies, he trains with Peter B. Parker and other Spider-People. He learns to use his own abilities and takes responsibility for stopping the collider instead of simply copying an established hero.

sherlock.sourceContext: Sherlock Holmes investigates cases through close observation, deduction and forensic reasoning, often working with Dr. Watson. He draws meaning from details other people dismiss and tests explanations against evidence. Watson accompanies him and records the cases, making the partnership central to how his investigations reach the reader.

beth-harmon.sourceContext: Beth Harmon learns chess from the orphanage custodian Mr. Shaibel and rises from local competitions to challenge leading Soviet players. Her extraordinary chess ability develops alongside dependence on tranquilizers and alcohol. Competitive achievement and the struggle with addiction remain intertwined rather than one simply resolving the other.

annalise.sourceContext: Annalise Keating is a criminal defense lawyer and law professor who selects five students to assist with her cases. They become entangled in murders, and her role as their protective mentor collides with professional duties and public scrutiny. Her courtroom authority does not remove the personal and ethical consequences of those entanglements.

katniss.sourceContext: Katniss volunteers for the Hunger Games in place of her younger sister Prim. When the rules demand one winner, she and Peeta threaten to eat poisonous berries, forcing the organizers to accept two. She later becomes the rebellion's public symbol while resisting how powerful groups try to use her image.

eleven.sourceContext: Eleven grows up under experimentation at Hawkins Lab and escapes into a friendship with Mike and the other children. She uses her powers to protect them from the Demogorgon. After living in hiding with Hopper, her wish to reconnect with her friends creates conflict between protection, freedom and belonging.

villanelle.sourceContext: Villanelle is recruited from prison to work as an assassin for the Twelve under a new identity. Her assignments become entangled with an obsessive pursuit of intelligence investigator Eve Polastri. Their attraction and rivalry repeatedly cross professional boundaries; her charm and style coexist with deliberate violence, not harmless rebellion.

hermione.sourceContext: Hermione Granger relies on study and careful recall to help Harry and Ron through danger. She uses a Time-Turner first for an overloaded class schedule and later to help rescue Sirius and Buckbeak. Her concern for house-elves also leads her to challenge practices that the wizarding community treats as normal.

harry-potter.sourceContext: Harry discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and finds friendship with Ron and Hermione at Hogwarts. Voldemort's murder of his parents and failed attempt to kill him tie his childhood to a larger conflict. In the final struggle, he goes willingly into the Forbidden Forest to face Voldemort rather than leave the danger to others.

matilda.sourceContext: Matilda teaches herself to read despite parents who dismiss her abilities. At school she finds support from Miss Honey and discovers how Miss Trunchbull has abused her teacher. Matilda uses her telekinetic power to make Trunchbull restore Miss Honey's inheritance, then finds a caring home with Miss Honey.

elizabeth-bennet.sourceContext: Elizabeth Bennet refuses Mr. Collins's proposal despite pressure to secure her family's future through marriage. She initially misjudges Darcy and trusts Wickham's account. Reading Darcy's letter makes her reconsider her own certainty, and their eventual relationship follows changes in both their judgments and behavior.

frodo.sourceContext: Frodo carries the One Ring toward Mordor with Sam's help, but at Mount Doom he cannot willingly destroy it; Gollum's intervention completes the quest. Returning home does not erase Frodo's physical and emotional wounds. He eventually leaves the Shire, showing the lasting cost of a task that others regard as successfully finished.

paddington.sourceContext: Paddington travels from Peru and is taken in by the Brown family after they meet him at a London railway station. He tries to navigate unfamiliar customs with politeness and a fondness for marmalade. His attempts to help often cause mishaps, while his hard stares challenge people who behave badly.

winston-churchill-q8016.sourceContext: Churchill began painting at forty after his political setback in 1915. It became a lasting pastime, and he later wrote about that experience in Painting as a Pastime.

pierre-de-fermat-q75655.sourceContext: In their 1654 correspondence, Fermat and Pascal examined how to divide stakes when a game stops before completion, comparing methods based on the remaining possible outcomes.

simone-biles-q7520267.sourceContext: At the Tokyo Olympics held in 2021, Biles withdrew from several events, continued supporting her teammates, and returned for the balance beam final. USA Gymnastics describes the withdrawal as protecting her health and safety.

dolly-parton-q180453.sourceContext: Parton founded the Imagination Library in her home county in 1995, arranging for children to receive books at home without cost to their families. Her father’s lack of access to literacy helped inspire the project.

katherine-johnson-q11740.sourceContext: Before John Glenn’s 1962 orbital flight, Johnson checked the electronic computer’s trajectory calculations by running the same equations herself on a mechanical calculating machine.

ada-lovelace-q7259.sourceContext: In her notes on the Analytical Engine, Lovelace considered how numbers could represent things beyond arithmetic, including musical notes, extending the imagined uses of the machine.

nelson-mandela-q8023.sourceContext: Mandela stepped down in 1999 after one presidential term, as he had promised, and continued public work through charitable foundations.

a-p-j-abdul-kalam-q9513.sourceContext: Kalam’s team adapted composite materials used in rockets to make lighter leg calipers for children. The Indian government’s account describes the work as applying space technology to a practical everyday burden.

amitabh-bachchan-q9570.sourceContext: Through UNICEF’s polio campaign, Bachchan used television and radio messages, public appearances, and field visits to encourage participation in immunization efforts led by health workers and partner organizations.

hedy-lamarr-q49034.sourceContext: Lamarr collaborated with composer George Antheil on a frequency-hopping communications technique, receiving a patent in 1942 under the name Hedy Kiesler Markey.

woody-q2290907.sourceContext: In Toy Story, Woody worries that Andy likes his new space ranger better and turns on Buzz. Once both toys are lost, getting back to Andy depends on working with the very toy Woody was trying to push away.

buzz-lightyear-q1986193.sourceContext: In Toy Story, Buzz arrives in Andy's room believing he is on a real space mission. When he and Woody are separated from Andy, the two rivals have to team up to find their way home.

munna-bhai-q6936780.sourceContext: At the hospital, Munna notices that patients thank the doctors while the cleaner goes unthanked. He stops to thank the man for his work and gives him a hug. The cleaner hesitates, then hugs him back.

chitti-q58057393.sourceContext: In Enthiran, Vaseegaran upgrades the robot Chitti so he can understand human feelings. Chitti falls for Sana, Vaseegaran's girlfriend. Giving the robot this new ability brings a feeling its inventor did not anticipate.

bhallaladeva-q38805060.sourceContext: In Baahubali: The Lost Legends, the young princes Bhallaladeva and Baahubali compete for the throne of Mahishmati. On their travels the same two rivals must defend the people they each hope to rule.

ms-dhoni-q470774.sourceContext: During India's chase in the 2011 cricket World Cup final, captain MS Dhoni moved himself up the batting order. Batting alongside Gautam Gambhir kept one right-hander and one left-hander at the crease. Dhoni stayed in and hit the winning six.

sachin-tendulkar-q9488.sourceContext: Sachin Tendulkar wanted to win the cricket World Cup from childhood. India lost the 2003 final. Eight years later, after winning with his teammates, he described what it felt like to have kept chasing that same dream.

lionel-messi-q615.sourceContext: Lionel Messi scored the opening goal against Saudi Arabia at the 2022 football World Cup, but Argentina lost the match. Afterwards he urged his teammates to stay together and turn their attention to the next game.

michael-jordan-q41421.sourceContext: After three NBA titles, Michael Jordan tried another sport. In 1994 he joined the Birmingham Barons, rode the team bus and played 127 minor-league baseball games.
